import argparse

import json
import math

import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
import psutil
from frequency_coverage import sample_camera_rgb

from phase_admission_protocol import owner_live, read, ref
from report_frequency_coverage import fingerprint, summarize
from spectral_selection_diversity import (
    pooled_score,
    select_pooled,
    selection_geometry,
    template_proximity,
)

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
ROOT = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V188-selection-diversity-v1"
PREVIOUS = ROOT.parent / "V187-pooled-wave-trial-v1"
COVERAGE = ROOT.parent / "V186-frequency-coverage-v1"
METHODS = ["V185_actual8slots", "V187_actual8", "FP64_pooled8", "spaced8", "sector8"]


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write("\n")


def lines(path):
    with gzip.open(path, "rt") as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f]


def completed():
    index = REPO / "docs/results/v187-pooled-wave-final-v1.json"
    proof = REPO / "docs/results/v187-pooled-wave-publication-verification-v1.json"
    final, verified = read(index), read(proof)
    assert final["status"].startswith("completed-") and verified["status"].startswith("pass-")
    assert verified["publication"] == ref(index)
    for k in ["report", "figures", "notes", "publication_source"]:
        assert ref(final[k]["path"]) == final[k]
    for name in ["wave-train", "review", "train-review-controller", "review-render-controller"]:
        assert not owner_live(read(PREVIOUS / f"{name}-launch-v1.json")["owner"])
        assert not (PREVIOUS / f"{name}-failure-v1.json").exists()
    for name in ["training-audit-v1.json", "quality-audit-v1.json"]:
        assert read(PREVIOUS / name)["status"].startswith("pass-")
    previous = read(PREVIOUS / "plan-v1.json")
    neural = {Path(p).name: h for p, h in previous["frozen_files"].items() if "/src/demosaic/" in p}
    assert len(neural) == 101
    for n, h in neural.items():
        assert ref(REPO / "src/demosaic" / n)["sha256"] == h
    diagnostic = REPO / "docs/results/v186-frequency-coverage-v1.json"
    diagnostic_proof = (
        REPO / "docs/results/v186-frequency-coverage-publication-verification-v1.json"
    )
    assert read(diagnostic_proof)["publication"] == ref(diagnostic)
    assert read(COVERAGE / "verification-v2.json")["status"].startswith("pass-")
    return {
        "publication": ref(index),
        "verification": ref(proof),
        "previous_plan": ref(PREVIOUS / "plan-v1.json"),
        "actual_selection_journal": ref(PREVIOUS / "quality-observations-v1.jsonl.gz"),
        "previous_scores": ref(PREVIOUS / "scores-v1.json"),
        "coverage_publication": ref(diagnostic),
        "coverage_verification": ref(diagnostic_proof),
        "old_inputs": ref(COVERAGE / "input-selections-v1.jsonl.gz"),
        "old_templates": ref(COVERAGE / "postselection-template-v1.jsonl.gz"),
        "coverage_plan": ref(COVERAGE / "plan-v1.json"),
        "neural101_hashes": neural,
    }


def prepare():
    dep = completed()
    assert not ROOT.exists()
    assert (
        shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free > 40.030 * 2**30
        and psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
    )
    tests = REPO / ".cache/v188-diversity-CPU-tests-v1.log"
    assert "20 passed" in tests.read_text()
    cases = read(dep["coverage_plan"]["path"])["cases"]
    assert len(cases) == 550 and sum(c["kind"] == "mesh" for c in cases) == 512
    ROOT.mkdir()
    work = ROOT / "work"
    sources = [
        "scripts/" + n + ".py"
        for n in [
            "report_selection_diversity",
            "spectral_selection_diversity",
            "frequency_coverage",
            "green_phase_spectrum",
            "local_phase_projection",
            "phase_admission_protocol",
            "report_frequency_coverage",
        ]
    ] + ["tests/test_spectral_selection_diversity.py"]
    for n in sources:
        d = work / n
        d.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(REPO / n, d)
    plan = {
        "status": "fixed-input-only-diverse-eight-slot-allocation-then-hidden-template-proximity-not-quality",
        "created_unix_UTC": time.time(),
        "runner": ref(work / "scripts/report_selection_diversity.py"),
        "sources": [dict(ref(work / n), text=(work / n).read_text()) for n in sources],
        "dependency": dep,
        "cases": cases,
        "methods": METHODS,
        "CPU_tests": ref(tests),
        "independent_case_ids": [c["id"] for c in cases[:12]],
        "local_floor_GiB": 40,
        "RAM_floor_GiB": 32,
        "new_local_forecast_GiB": 0.030,
        "new_external_writes": 0,
        "scope": "Previous turn was progress: completed/published V187 matched508parameter900update run, both822case endpoints, independent audits and actual60native views. Residual weak crossings/falsewaves motivate this diagnostic. Reuse actual V185 and V187 bins; FP64 pooled8 bridges numerical ranking. Same two-green9neighbor pooled score, 1/16..1/3 center band,8slots for all counterfactuals. Spaced8 changes NMS radius from1 toceil(maxpackedaxis/65), leaving rank greedy; sector8 uses radius1 and at most2picks per four fixed45degree principal sectors. Absolute angular boundaries are arbitrary; postselection sector summaries use0 and22.5degree partitions, with minima only among sectors carrying at least5percent principal template energy. No target, reference, response or predictedRGB influences input selection. Parse closed V187 quality journal only for input bindings/bins; all550input rows close before clean arrays/saved response interpretation. Descriptive principal-CFA template proximity is not recovered amplitude, an upper bound, confidence, independent replications or a blind safety test. All512present/absent templates reuse exact present-minus-empty arrays; absent templates are hypothetical,not signal. Controls are32quiet+6real contexts/40ROIs; selected both-phase/local powers are not holdout tests. Real ISO100/AHD/JPEG refs never read or scored. No neural/checkpoint/model load, newRGB, decoder, source/noise draw, original/dataz access or neural-source changes. All101older neural files/receipts/checkpoints preserved. Allnew outputs local withprospective40GiBbuffer;externalread-only.",
    }
    save(ROOT / "plan-v1.json", plan)
    print("Prepared550inputcontexts/512postselectiontemplates/40ROIs;zero new model or quality")


def guard(plan):
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    for b in plan["sources"]:
        assert ref(b["path"]) == {k: b[k] for k in ["path", "sha256"]}
    for k, b in plan["dependency"].items():
        if k != "neural101_hashes":
            assert ref(b["path"]) == b


def resources(plan):
    while (
        shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free <= plan["local_floor_GiB"] * 2**30
        or psutil.virtual_memory().available <= plan["RAM_floor_GiB"] * 2**30
    ):
        print("Waiting before next CPU case for recorded local/RAM floor", flush=True)
        time.sleep(5)


def run():
    p = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(p)
    completed()
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    for _ in range(60):
        if (ROOT / "launch-v1.json").exists() and read(ROOT / "launch-v1.json")["owner"] == owner:
            break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing actual launch binding")
    (ROOT / "run.claim").open("x").close()
    save(ROOT / "owner-v1.json", owner)
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, [8, 9])
    started = time.time()
    old = {r["id"]: r for r in lines(p["dependency"]["old_inputs"]["path"])}
    actual = {}
    ids = set(old)
    with gzip.open(p["dependency"]["actual_selection_journal"]["path"], "rt") as f:
        for line in f:
            r = json.loads(line)
            if r["method"] == "V187-pooled-wave-raw" and r["id"] in ids:
                s = r["pooled"]["selection"]
                assert np.asarray(s["valid"]).all()
                actual[r["id"]] = {
                    "bins": np.asarray(s["bin_yx"])[0].transpose(1, 0, 2).reshape(-1, 2).tolist(),
                    "inputs": r["inputs"],
                }
    assert len(actual) == 550
    selections = []
    mismatches = []
    with gzip.open(ROOT / "input-selections-v1.jsonl.gz", "xt", compresslevel=6) as f:
        for index, c in enumerate(p["cases"]):
            resources(p)
            assert ref(c["arrays"]["path"]) == c["arrays"]
            with np.load(c["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as a:
                raw, var, colors = [a[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors"]]
            inputs = {
                k: fingerprint(v)
                for k, v in zip(["packed", "variance", "colors"], [raw, var, colors], strict=True)
            }
            assert len(raw) == 1 and all(
                v == actual[c["id"]]["inputs"][k] == old[c["id"]]["inputs"][k]
                for k, v in inputs.items()
            )
            score, powers, greens = pooled_score(raw[0], var[0], colors[0])
            shape = score.shape
            r = math.ceil(max(shape) / 65)
            choices = {
                "V185_actual8slots": np.asarray(old[c["id"]]["bins"]["actual_high4"])
                .reshape(-1, 2)
                .tolist(),
                "V187_actual8": actual[c["id"]]["bins"],
            }
            for name, kw in [
                ("FP64_pooled8", {}),
                ("spaced8", {"radius": r}),
                ("sector8", {"quota": 2}),
            ]:
                choices[name] = select_pooled(score, **kw)["bins"]
            same = choices["V187_actual8"] == choices["FP64_pooled8"]
            if not same:
                mismatches.append(c["id"])
            stats = {}
            for method, bins in choices.items():
                assert len(bins) == 8
                y, x = np.asarray(bins).T
                phase = powers[:, y, x].T
                stats[method] = {
                    "global_two_phase_power": phase.tolist(),
                    "pooled_scores": score[y, x].tolist(),
                    "geometry_localwidth": selection_geometry(shape, bins, r),
                    "geometry_near1": selection_geometry(shape, bins, 1),
                    "global_max_min_phase_power": float(phase.min(1).max()),
                }
            row = {
                "index": index,
                "id": c["id"],
                "kind": c["kind"],
                "present": c.get("present"),
                "noise": c.get("noise", {}).get("name"),
                "arrays": c["arrays"],
                "inputs": inputs,
                "shape": list(shape),
                "colors": colors.tolist(),
                "bins": choices,
                "stats": stats,
                "actual_FP64_bins_exact": same,
            }
            selections.append(row)
            f.write(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            f.flush()
            if (index + 1) % 50 == 0:
                print("input-only", index + 1, "/550", flush=True)
    save(
        ROOT / "input-completion-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "closed-all550input-only-allocations-before-clean-template-reads",
            "owner": owner,
            "journal": ref(ROOT / "input-selections-v1.jsonl.gz"),
            "cases": 550,
            "target_reads_before_close": 0,
            "FP64_bridge_mismatches": mismatches,
        },
    )
    # Only now are clean arrays and old diagnostic fractions interpreted.
    previous_templates = {r["id"]: r for r in lines(p["dependency"]["old_templates"]["path"])}
    scored = []
    controls = []
    unique_local = 0
    with (
        gzip.open(ROOT / "template-proximity-v1.jsonl.gz", "xt", compresslevel=6) as sf,
        gzip.open(ROOT / "control-ROI-v1.jsonl.gz", "xt", compresslevel=6) as cf,
    ):
        for c, s in zip(p["cases"], selections, strict=True):
            resources(p)
            assert c["id"] == s["id"]
            if c["kind"] == "mesh":
                with np.load(c["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as a:
                    colors = a["colors"]
                    present = np.maximum(a["target_present"], np.float32(0))
                    empty = np.maximum(a["target_empty"], np.float32(0))
                clean = sample_camera_rgb(present, colors).astype(float) - sample_camera_rgb(
                    empty, colors
                ).astype(float)
                greens = np.flatnonzero(colors[0] == 1)
                spectra = [tapered_spectrum(clean[0, g])["spectrum"] for g in greens]
                power = sum(abs(z) ** 2 for z in spectra)
                oldrow = previous_templates[c["id"]]
                assert (
                    fingerprint(clean) == oldrow["template_sensor_values"]
                    and fingerprint(power) == oldrow["template_power"]
                )
                for method in METHODS:
                    for label, radius in [
                        ("near1", 1),
                        ("localwidth", math.ceil(max(power.shape) / 65)),
                    ]:
                        v = template_proximity(power, s["bins"][method], radius)
                        if method == "V185_actual8slots":
                            assert (
                                abs(
                                    v["all_template_fraction"]
                                    - oldrow[f"actual_high4_{label}_template_fraction"]
                                )
                                < 1e-14
                            )
                        row = {
                            "id": c["id"],
                            "kind": "mesh",
                            "present": c["present"],
                            "method": method,
                            "neighborhood": label,
                            "radius": radius,
                            "template_sensor_values": fingerprint(clean),
                            "template_power": fingerprint(power),
                            "template_fraction": v["all_template_fraction"],
                            "minimum_substantial_sector_fraction_0": v["sectors"]["0"][
                                "minimum_proximity_among_sectors_with_at_least_5percent_power"
                            ],
                            "minimum_substantial_sector_fraction_22p5": v["sectors"]["22.5"][
                                "minimum_proximity_among_sectors_with_at_least_5percent_power"
                            ],
                            "sector_details": v["sectors"],
                        }
                        scored.append(row)
                        sf.write(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                        sf.flush()
            else:
                with np.load(c["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as a:
                    raw, var, colors = [a[k] for k in ["packed", "variance", "colors"]]
                regions = (
                    [{"name": c["id"], "ROI_xywh": c["ROI_xywh"]}]
                    if "ROI_xywh" in c
                    else c["source"]["cases"]
                )
                for region in regions:
                    x, y, w, h = region["ROI_xywh"]
                    center = np.asarray([[(y + h // 2) // 2, (x + w // 2) // 2]], dtype=np.int64)
                    greens = np.flatnonzero(colors[0] == 1)
                    cache = {}
                    for method in METHODS:
                        powers = []
                        for by, bx in s["bins"][method]:
                            values = []
                            for phase in greens:
                                key = (int(phase), by, bx)
                                if key not in cache:
                                    v = local_phase_projection(
                                        raw[0, phase],
                                        var[0, phase],
                                        [by, bx],
                                        window=65,
                                        centers_yx=center,
                                    )
                                    cache[key] = float(
                                        abs(v["coefficient"][0]) ** 2
                                        / max(float(v["noise_variance"][0]), (1 / 65535) ** 2)
                                    )
                                    unique_local += 1
                                values.append(cache[key])
                            powers.append(values)
                        row = {
                            "id": c["id"],
                            "ROI_name": region["name"],
                            "ROI_xywh": region["ROI_xywh"],
                            "kind": c["kind"],
                            "noise": s["noise"],
                            "method": method,
                            "center_packed_yx": center.tolist(),
                            "window": 65,
                            "bins": s["bins"][method],
                            "local_two_phase_power": powers,
                            "local_max_min_phase_power": float(np.asarray(powers).min(1).max()),
                            "global_max_min_phase_power": s["stats"][method][
                                "global_max_min_phase_power"
                            ],
                        }
                        controls.append(row)
                        cf.write(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                        cf.flush()
    assert len(scored) == 5120 and len(controls) == 200
    result = {
        "status": "completed-550input-allocations-512hidden-template-cases-40local-ROIs-not-new-denoising-quality",
        "owner": owner,
        "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
        "input_completion": ref(ROOT / "input-completion-v1.json"),
        "input_journal": ref(ROOT / "input-selections-v1.jsonl.gz"),
        "template_journal": ref(ROOT / "template-proximity-v1.jsonl.gz"),
        "control_journal": ref(ROOT / "control-ROI-v1.jsonl.gz"),
        "input_cases": 550,
        "template_cases": 512,
        "template_measurements": len(scored),
        "ROI_method_measurements": len(controls),
        "stored_local_powers": sum(np.asarray(r["local_two_phase_power"]).size for r in controls),
        "unique_local_power_evaluations": unique_local,
        "FP64_bridge_mismatches": mismatches,
        "template_summary": summarize(scored, ["method", "present", "neighborhood"]),
        "control_summary": summarize(controls, ["method", "kind"]),
        "maximum_RSS_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss * 1024,
        "wall_seconds": time.time() - started,
        "new_neural_forwards": 0,
        "new_RGB_arrays": 0,
        "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
        "checkpoint_loads": 0,
        "scope": p["scope"],
    }
    assert "torch" not in sys.modules and "rawpy" not in sys.modules
    guard(p)
    save(ROOT / "result-v1.json", result)
    print("PASS550inputs/512templates/200ROI-methods/3200localpowers;no new inference", flush=True)


def launch():
    p = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(p)
    assert not (ROOT / "launch-v1.json").exists() and not (ROOT / "run.claim").exists()
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT / "work/scripts"),
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",
        MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
    )
    with (ROOT / "run-v1.log").open("xb") as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"), p["runner"]["path"], "run"],
            cwd=REPO,
            env=env,
            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
    owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
    save(
        ROOT / "launch-v1.json",
        {"owner": owner, "runner": p["runner"], "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")},
    )
    print(json.dumps(owner))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prepare", "launch", "run"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.phase != "run":
        {"prepare": prepare, "launch": launch}[args.phase]()
    else:
        try:
            run()
        except BaseException as exc:
            save(ROOT / "failure-v1.json", {"error": repr(exc), "time_UTC": time.time()})
            raise

"""Input-only pooled spectral allocation; diagnostic fractions are not recovery bounds."""

import math

import numpy as np
from frequency_coverage import eligible_bins, footprint, power_fraction
from green_phase_spectrum import tapered_spectrum


def sector_map(shape, *, offset=0):
    if len(shape) != 2 or min(shape) < 8 or not math.isfinite(offset):
        raise ValueError("Expected axes>=8 and finite angle offset")
    fy, fx = [np.fft.fftfreq(n) / 2 for n in shape]
    angle = np.mod(np.arctan2(fy[:, None], fx[None, :]) - offset, math.pi)
    return np.minimum((angle / (math.pi / 4)).astype(np.int64), 3)


def pooled_score(packed, variance, colors):
    packed, variance, colors = map(np.asarray, (packed, variance, colors))
    if (
        packed.ndim != 3
        or packed.shape[0] != 4
        or variance.shape != packed.shape
        or colors.shape != (4,)
        or tuple(colors) not in {(0, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 2, 1), (1, 2, 0, 1)}
        or not np.isfinite(packed).all()
        or not np.isfinite(variance).all()
        or (variance < 0).any()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected finite four-phase RAW/variance and a Bayer layout")
    greens = np.flatnonzero(colors == 1)
    fields = [tapered_spectrum(packed[g], variance[g]) for g in greens]
    powers = np.stack(
        [
            abs(f["spectrum"]) ** 2 / np.maximum(f["noise_variance"], (1 / 65535) ** 2)
            for f in fields
        ]
    )
    mean = powers.mean(0)
    score = sum(np.roll(mean, (dy, dx), (0, 1)) for dy in [-1, 0, 1] for dx in [-1, 0, 1]) / 9
    return score, powers, greens


def select_pooled(score, *, count=8, radius=1, quota=None, offset=0):
    """Greedy pooled ranking, optionally larger NMS or at most two slots per sector.

    Full/no-quota reproduces V187's FP64 reference. Four fixed principal angular
    sectors with quota2 use no target. A quota can force noise-only selections;
    no output field represents confidence. Ties use original row-major order.
    """
    score = np.asarray(score)
    if (
        score.ndim != 2
        or not np.isfinite(score).all()
        or (score < 0).any()
        or type(count) is not int
        or not 1 <= count <= 16
        or type(radius) is not int
        or radius < 1
        or quota not in (None, 2)
        or (quota == 2 and count != 8)
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Expected nonnegative finite power, count1..16, radius>=1 and optional quota2"
        )
    available = eligible_bins(score.shape, 1 / 16, 1 / 3)
    sectors = sector_map(score.shape, offset=offset)
    used = np.zeros(4, dtype=np.int64)
    bins, values = [], []
    h, w = score.shape
    for _ in range(count):
        allowed = available if quota is None else available & (used[sectors] < quota)
        ranked = np.where(allowed, score, -np.inf)
        flat = int(np.argmax(ranked))
        if not np.isfinite(ranked.flat[flat]):
            break
        y, x = divmod(flat, w)
        bins.append([y, x])
        values.append(float(score[y, x]))
        used[sectors[y, x]] += 1
        for cy, cx in [(y, x), ((-y) % h, (-x) % w)]:
            for dy in range(-radius, radius + 1):
                for dx in range(-radius, radius + 1):
                    available[(cy + dy) % h, (cx + dx) % w] = False
    return {"bins": bins, "scores": values, "sector_counts": used.tolist(), "radius": radius}


def selection_geometry(shape, bins, radius):
    bins = np.asarray(bins, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 2)
    mask = footprint(shape, bins, radius)
    # Conjugate neighborhoods can overlap, including at the Nyquist boundary.
    independent_area = len(bins) * 2 * (2 * radius + 1) ** 2
    return {
        "slots": len(bins),
        "unique_bins": len(set(map(tuple, bins))),
        "footprint_cells": int(mask.sum()),
        "overlap_fraction_of_unclipped_sum": 1 - float(mask.sum()) / independent_area,
        "occupied_sectors": len(set(sector_map(shape)[tuple(bins.T)])) if len(bins) else 0,
    }


def template_proximity(power, bins, radius):
    """Descriptive clean principal-CFA spectral proximity, never amplitude recovery."""
    power = np.asarray(power)
    mask = footprint(power.shape, bins, radius)
    fraction = power_fraction(power, mask)
    principal = eligible_bins(power.shape, 1e-12, math.sqrt(2) / 4)
    # Principal half-plane partitions exclude self-conjugate/DC boundary bins.
    # Sector summaries are restricted to that fixed half-plane, not all energy.
    sectors = {}
    for degrees in [0, 22.5]:
        labels = sector_map(power.shape, offset=math.radians(degrees))
        energy, covered, captured = [], [], []
        total = float(power[principal].sum())
        for s in range(4):
            cells = principal & (labels == s)
            e = float(power[cells].sum())
            energy.append(e / total if total else 0)
            v = float(power[cells & mask].sum())
            captured.append(v / total if total else 0)
            covered.append(v / e if e else None)

"""NumPy diagnostics of separately measured green CFA planes, not restoration.

Phase compensation describes the principal packed-grid band. Aliases can reverse
the signed cross-spectrum; a four-native-pixel carrier can even vanish in one
green phase. Agreement is therefore neither an all-frequency signal detector
nor a calibrated photographic confidence measure.
"""

import numpy as np


def _geometry(shape):
    height, width = shape
    if min(shape) < 8:
        raise ValueError("Spectral fields need at least eight samples per axis")
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-1, 1, height), np.linspace(-1, 1, width), indexing="ij")
    basis = np.stack((np.ones(shape), x, y), axis=-1)
    window = np.hanning(height)[:, None] * np.hanning(width)[None, :]
    gram = np.einsum("hwi,hwj,hw->ij", basis, basis, window**2)
    return basis, window, np.linalg.inv(gram)


def tapered_spectrum(image, variance=None):
    """Hann-taper a weighted-plane residual and propagate independent noise.

    For Q=[1,x,y], W=diag(Hann), beta=(Q'W²Q)^-1 Q'W²image.
    The Fourier operator is F W (I-Q(Q'W²Q)^-1 Q'W²). Its per-coefficient
    noise variance includes the fitted-plane terms, not just mean input noise.
    This is conditional linear propagation for supplied independent variances;
    observed-signal variance proxies are not established camera-noise truth.
    """
    image = np.asarray(image, dtype=np.float64)
    if image.ndim != 2 or not np.isfinite(image).all():
        raise ValueError("Expected one finite real image plane")
    basis, window, inverse = _geometry(image.shape)
    beta = inverse @ np.einsum("hwi,hw,hw->i", basis, window**2, image)
    residual = window * (image - np.einsum("hwi,i->hw", basis, beta))
    spectrum = np.fft.fft2(residual, norm="ortho")
    noise = None
    if variance is not None:
        variance = np.asarray(variance, dtype=np.float64)
        if variance.shape != image.shape or not np.isfinite(variance).all() or (variance < 0).any():
            raise ValueError("Variance must be finite, nonnegative and match the image")
        # t_k = a_k - h_k (W² Q)', with a_k the tapered Fourier row.
        transformed_basis = np.fft.fft2(window[..., None] * basis, axes=(0, 1), norm="ortho")
        h = transformed_basis @ inverse
        cross = np.fft.fft2((variance * window**3)[..., None] * basis, axes=(0, 1), norm="ortho")
        covariance = np.einsum("hwi,hwj,hw->ij", basis, basis, variance * window**4)
        base = float(np.mean(variance * window**2))
        noise = (
            base
            - 2 * np.real(np.sum(np.conj(h) * cross, axis=-1))
            + np.real(np.einsum("hwi,ij,hwj->hw", h, covariance, np.conj(h)))
        )
        if np.min(noise) < -1e-10 * max(base, np.finfo(np.float64).tiny):
            raise ArithmeticError("Propagated spectral noise variance became negative")
        noise = np.maximum(noise, 0)
    return {"spectrum": spectrum, "noise_variance": noise, "plane": beta}


def _average3(values):
    return sum(np.roll(values, (y, x), axis=(0, 1)) for y in (-1, 0, 1) for x in (-1, 0, 1)) / 9


def green_pair(packed, variance, colors):
    """Describe both greens on an even-origin four-phase packed RAW field.

    The 3×3 frequency average is not nine independent observations. Its signed
    coherence is bounded by Cauchy-Schwarz, but is not a test probability.
    Noise-normalized cross power has no calibrated false-discovery threshold.
    """
    packed = np.asarray(packed, dtype=np.float64)
    variance = np.asarray(variance, dtype=np.float64)
    colors = np.asarray(colors)
    allowed = {(0, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 2, 1), (1, 2, 0, 1)}
    if (
        packed.ndim != 3
        or packed.shape[0] != 4
        or variance.shape != packed.shape
        or colors.shape != (4,)
        or tuple(colors) not in allowed
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected matching 4×H×W RAW/variance and a standard Bayer layout")
    indices = np.flatnonzero(colors == 1)
    first, second = [tapered_spectrum(packed[i], variance[i]) for i in indices]
    height, width = packed.shape[-2:]
    fy = np.fft.fftfreq(height)[:, None] / 2
    fx = np.fft.fftfreq(width)[None, :] / 2
    y0, x0 = divmod(int(indices[0]), 2)
    y1, x1 = divmod(int(indices[1]), 2)
    alignment = np.exp(2j * np.pi * ((y1 - y0) * fy + (x1 - x0) * fx))
    cross = first["spectrum"] * np.conj(second["spectrum"]) * alignment
    power = np.stack([np.abs(item["spectrum"]) ** 2 for item in (first, second)])
    averaged_cross = _average3(cross)
    averaged_power = np.stack([_average3(p) for p in power])
    denominator = np.sqrt(averaged_power[0] * averaged_power[1])
    coherence = np.divide(
        averaged_cross,
        denominator,
        out=np.zeros_like(averaged_cross),
        where=denominator > np.finfo(np.float64).tiny,
    )
    if np.max(np.abs(coherence)) > 1 + 1e-12:
        raise ArithmeticError("Smoothed cross-spectrum violates Cauchy-Schwarz")
    noise = np.stack([item["noise_variance"] for item in (first, second)])
    averaged_noise = np.stack([_average3(v) for v in noise])
    scale = np.sqrt(averaged_noise[0] * averaged_noise[1])
    normalized_cross = None
    normalized_power = None
    if np.all(scale > 0) and np.all(averaged_noise > 0):
        normalized_cross = np.real(averaged_cross) / scale
        normalized_power = np.mean(averaged_power / averaged_noise, axis=0)
    return {
        "green_phase_indices": indices,
        "spectra": np.stack([first["spectrum"], second["spectrum"]]),
        "noise_variance": noise,
        "power": power,
        "aligned_cross": cross,
        "average_cross": averaged_cross,
        "signed_coherence": np.real(coherence),
        "complex_coherence": coherence,
        "noise_units_signed_cross": normalized_cross,
        "noise_units_mean_phase_power": normalized_power,
        "native_fx": np.broadcast_to(fx, (height, width)).copy(),
        "native_fy": np.broadcast_to(fy, (height, width)).copy(),
        "removed_planes": np.stack([first["plane"], second["plane"]]),
    }


def cross_decomposition(packed, reference, variance, colors):
    """Separate reference, residual and mixed terms in observed green cross-power.

    This is an algebraic diagnostic, not an independence or unbiasedness claim.
    The residual can include added noise, ADC quantization/clipping and reference
    mismatch. A low-noise camera estimate must not be called noiseless GT.
    """
    observed = green_pair(packed, variance, colors)
    target = green_pair(reference, variance, colors)
    if np.shape(reference) != np.shape(packed):
        raise ValueError("Reference must match packed observation geometry")
    signal = target["spectra"]
    residual = observed["spectra"] - signal
    first, second = observed["green_phase_indices"]
    y0, x0 = divmod(int(first), 2)
    y1, x1 = divmod(int(second), 2)
    alignment = np.exp(
        2j * np.pi * ((y1 - y0) * observed["native_fy"] + (x1 - x0) * observed["native_fx"])
    )
    products = {
        "reference": signal[0] * np.conj(signal[1]),
        "residual": residual[0] * np.conj(residual[1]),
        "mixed": signal[0] * np.conj(residual[1]) + residual[0] * np.conj(signal[1]),
    }
    cross = {name: _average3(value * alignment) for name, value in products.items()}
    total = sum(cross.values())
    scale = max(float(np.max(np.abs(observed["average_cross"]))), np.finfo(float).tiny)
    if np.max(np.abs(total - observed["average_cross"])) > 64 * np.finfo(float).eps * scale:
        raise ArithmeticError("Reference/residual/mixed cross-power identity failed")
    noise_scale = np.sqrt(
        np.prod(np.stack([_average3(v) for v in observed["noise_variance"]]), axis=0)
    )
    normalized = None
    if np.all(noise_scale > 0):
        normalized = {name: value.real / noise_scale for name, value in cross.items()}
    return {
        "observed": observed,
        "reference": target,
        "component_cross": cross,
        "noise_units_components": normalized,
    }

"""Local linear Fourier measurements with exact supplied-noise propagation.

Frequency selection is external. Each clipped rectangular window removes its
own affine plane. No target, threshold, RGB restoration or learned model enters
these measurements. Observed-intensity variance proxies are not calibrated
confidence, and native CFA aliases remain unresolved.
"""

import math

import numpy as np


def box_sums(values, boxes):
    values, boxes = np.asarray(values), np.asarray(boxes)
    if (
        values.ndim != 2
        or boxes.ndim != 2
        or boxes.shape[1] != 4
        or not np.issubdtype(boxes.dtype, np.integer)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected a 2D field and integer Nx4 xywh boxes")
    x, y, width, height = boxes.T
    if not (
        (x >= 0)
        & (y >= 0)
        & (width > 0)
        & (height > 0)
        & (x + width <= values.shape[1])
        & (y + height <= values.shape[0])
    ).all():
        raise ValueError("Boxes must lie inside the field")
    integral = np.pad(values.cumsum(0).cumsum(1), ((1, 0), (1, 0)))
    return (
        integral[y + height, x + width]
        - integral[y, x + width]
        - integral[y + height, x]
        + integral[y, x]
    )


def local_phase_projection(image, variance, bin_yx, *, window, centers_yx):
    """Return complex box coefficients and their conditional variance.

    For local Q=[1,x-cx,y-cy], a=carrier-Q(Q'Q)^-1Q'carrier and c=a'image.
    The variance is sum(variance*abs(a)^2), including the fitted-plane terms.
    Summed-area moments evaluate these rows without constructing every patch.
    Partial edge windows use actual clipped support, without padding data.
    """
    image = np.asarray(image, dtype=np.float64)
    variance = np.asarray(variance, dtype=np.float64)
    centers = np.asarray(centers_yx)
    frequency = np.asarray(bin_yx)
    if image.ndim != 2 or min(image.shape) < 8 or variance.shape != image.shape:
        raise ValueError("Expected matching image/variance with axes at least eight")
    if not np.isfinite(image).all() or not np.isfinite(variance).all() or (variance < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Expected finite image and nonnegative finite variance")
    if type(window) is not int or window < 3 or window % 2 != 1:
        raise ValueError("Window must be an odd integer at least three")
    if (
        centers.ndim != 2
        or centers.shape[1] != 2
        or not len(centers)
        or not np.issubdtype(centers.dtype, np.integer)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected nonempty integer Nx2 yx centers")
    height, width = image.shape
    if not ((centers >= 0) & (centers < [height, width])).all():
        raise ValueError("Centers must lie inside the field")
    if (
        frequency.shape != (2,)
        or not np.issubdtype(frequency.dtype, np.integer)
        or not ((frequency >= 0) & (frequency < [height, width])).all()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected an in-range integer Fourier bin")
    radius = window // 2
    start = np.maximum(centers - radius, 0)
    end = np.minimum(centers + radius + 1, [height, width])
    boxes = np.stack(
        (start[:, 1], start[:, 0], end[:, 1] - start[:, 1], end[:, 0] - start[:, 0]), 1
    )
    x0, y0, nx, ny = boxes.T
    cx, cy = x0 + (nx - 1) / 2, y0 + (ny - 1) / 2
    count = nx * ny
    xx = ny * nx * (nx**2 - 1) / 12
    yy = nx * ny * (ny**2 - 1) / 12
    y, x = np.mgrid[:height, :width]
    ky, kx = [
        int(k if k <= (size - 1) // 2 else k - size)
        for k, size in zip(frequency, image.shape, strict=True)
    ]
    period = math.lcm(height, width)
    phase = (ky * y * (period // height) + kx * x * (period // width)) % period
    phase = np.where(phase > period // 2, phase - period, phase)
    carrier = np.exp(-2j * np.pi * phase / period)

    def total(field):
        return box_sums(field, boxes)

    m0 = total(carrier)
    mx = total(x * carrier) - cx * m0
    my = total(y * carrier) - cy * m0
    k0, kx, ky = m0 / count, mx / xx, my / yy
    centered = image - image[0, 0]
    mean = total(centered)
    coefficient = total(centered * carrier) - k0 * mean
    coefficient -= kx * (total(centered * x) - cx * mean)
    coefficient -= ky * (total(centered * y) - cy * mean)

    v0 = total(variance)
    vx0, vy0 = total(variance * x), total(variance * y)
    vx, vy = vx0 - cx * v0, vy0 - cy * v0
    vxx = total(variance * x**2) - 2 * cx * vx0 + cx**2 * v0
    vyy = total(variance * y**2) - 2 * cy * vy0 + cy**2 * v0
    vxy = total(variance * x * y) - cx * vy0 - cy * vx0 + cx * cy * v0
    vc = total(variance * carrier)
    vxc, vyc = total(variance * x * carrier) - cx * vc, total(variance * y * carrier) - cy * vc
    noise = v0 - 2 * np.real(k0.conj() * vc + kx.conj() * vxc + ky.conj() * vyc)
    noise += abs(k0) ** 2 * v0 + abs(kx) ** 2 * vxx + abs(ky) ** 2 * vyy
    noise += 2 * np.real(k0.conj() * kx * vx + k0.conj() * ky * vy + kx.conj() * ky * vxy)
    if not np.isfinite(coefficient).all() or not np.isfinite(noise).all():
        raise ArithmeticError("Nonfinite projected coefficients or variance")
    if (noise < -2e-9 * np.maximum(v0, np.finfo(float).tiny)).any():
        raise ArithmeticError("Negative propagated variance beyond rounding")
    return {"coefficient": coefficient, "noise_variance": np.maximum(noise, 0), "boxes_xywh": boxes}

"""Independent orthonormal-QR spectral rows and explicit rectangular DFT rows."""

import math

import numpy as np


def qr_spectrum(image, variance):
    image, variance = np.asarray(image, dtype=float), np.asarray(variance, dtype=float)
    h, w = image.shape
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-1, 1, h), np.linspace(-1, 1, w), indexing="ij")
    window = np.hanning(h)[:, None] * np.hanning(w)[None, :]
    basis = np.stack((np.ones_like(y), x, y), axis=-1).reshape(-1, 3)
    q = np.linalg.qr(window.ravel()[:, None] * basis, mode="reduced")[0]
    weighted = (image - image[0, 0]).ravel() * window.ravel()
    residual = (weighted - q @ (q.T @ weighted)).reshape(h, w)
    spectrum = np.fft.fft2(residual, norm="ortho")
    qgrid = q.reshape(h, w, 3)
    fq = np.fft.fft2(qgrid, axes=(0, 1), norm="ortho")
    effective = variance * window**2
    cross = np.fft.fft2(effective[..., None] * qgrid, axes=(0, 1), norm="ortho")
    covariance = q.T @ (effective.ravel()[:, None] * q)
    noise = effective.mean() - 2 * (fq.conj() * cross).sum(-1).real
    noise += np.einsum("hwi,ij,hwj->hw", fq, covariance, fq.conj()).real
    return spectrum, np.maximum(noise, 0), q, window


def dense_spectral_row(shape, bin_yx, q, window):
    y, x = np.indices(shape)
    ky, kx = bin_yx
    row = np.exp(-2j * np.pi * (ky * y / shape[0] + kx * x / shape[1])).ravel() / math.sqrt(
        np.prod(shape)
    )
    return (row - (row @ q) @ q.T) * window.ravel()


def sorted_select(spectrum, variance, lower, upper, inclusive=True, count=4):
    h, w = spectrum.shape
    fy, fx = [np.fft.fftfreq(n) / 2 for n in [h, w]]
    y, x = np.indices((h, w))
    r = np.hypot(fy[:, None], fx[None, :])
    allowed = (
        (r >= lower)
        & ((r <= upper) if inclusive else (r < upper))
        & ((fy[:, None] > 0) | ((fy[:, None] == 0) & (fx[None, :] > 0)))
    )
    yy, xx = y[allowed], x[allowed]
    power = abs(spectrum[allowed]) ** 2 / variance[allowed]
    order = np.lexsort((xx, yy, -power))
    result = []
    for i in order:
        cy, cx = int(yy[i]), int(xx[i])
        suppressed = False
        for sy, sx in result:
            for a, b in [(sy, sx), ((-sy) % h, (-sx) % w)]:
                if (
                    min(abs(cy - a), h - abs(cy - a)) <= 1
                    and min(abs(cx - b), w - abs(cx - b)) <= 1
                ):
                    suppressed = True
        if not suppressed:
            result.append([cy, cx])
        if len(result) == count:
            break
    return result


def independent_footprint(shape, bins, radius):
    y, x = np.indices(shape)
    covered = np.zeros(shape, bool)
    for sy, sx in bins:
        for a, b in [(sy, sx), ((-sy) % shape[0], (-sx) % shape[1])]:
            dy = np.abs(y - a)
            dx = np.abs(x - b)
            covered |= (np.minimum(dy, shape[0] - dy) <= radius) & (
                np.minimum(dx, shape[1] - dx) <= radius
            )
    return covered


def direct_local_power(raw, variance, bin_yx, center, window=65):
    h, w = raw.shape
    cy, cx = center
    y0, y1 = max(0, cy - window // 2), min(h, cy + window // 2 + 1)
    x0, x1 = max(0, cx - window // 2), min(w, cx + window // 2 + 1)
    y, x = np.mgrid[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    basis = np.stack((np.ones_like(x), x - x.mean(), y - y.mean()), axis=-1).reshape(-1, 3)
    q = np.linalg.qr(basis.astype(float), mode="reduced")[0]
    ky, kx = [k if k <= (n - 1) // 2 else k - n for k, n in zip(bin_yx, [h, w], strict=True)]
    row = np.exp(-2j * np.pi * (ky * y / h + kx * x / w)).ravel()
    row -= (row @ q) @ q.T
    values = raw[y0:y1, x0:x1].astype(float).ravel()
    values = values - values[0]
    coefficient = row @ values
    noise = (abs(row) ** 2) @ variance[y0:y1, x0:x1].astype(float).ravel()
    return float(abs(coefficient) ** 2 / max(float(noise), (1 / 65535) ** 2))

"""Separate sorted-list selection, toroidal geometry and QR template reference."""

import math

import numpy as np
from frequency_coverage_reference import independent_footprint, qr_spectrum


def sorted_pooled(score, radius, quota=None):
    h, w = score.shape
    fy, fx = [np.fft.fftfreq(n) / 2 for n in (h, w)]
    y, x = np.indices((h, w))
    rad = np.hypot(fy[:, None], fx[None, :])
    valid = (
        (rad >= 1 / 16)
        & (rad <= 1 / 3)
        & ((fy[:, None] > 0) | ((fy[:, None] == 0) & (fx[None, :] > 0)))
    )
    ys, xs = y[valid], x[valid]
    order = np.lexsort((xs, ys, -score[valid]))
    chosen = []
    counts = [0] * 4
    for q in order:
        a, b = int(ys[q]), int(xs[q])
        sector = min(int((math.atan2(fy[a], fx[b]) % math.pi) / (math.pi / 4)), 3)
        if quota is not None and counts[sector] >= quota:
            continue
        reject = False
        for cy, cx in chosen:
            for dy, dx in [(cy, cx), ((-cy) % h, (-cx) % w)]:
                if (
                    min(abs(a - dy), h - abs(a - dy)) <= radius
                    and min(abs(b - dx), w - abs(b - dx)) <= radius
                ):
                    reject = True
        if not reject:
            chosen.append([a, b])
            counts[sector] += 1
        if len(chosen) == 8:
            break
    return chosen


def qr_pooled(raw, variance, greens):
    fields = [qr_spectrum(raw[g], variance[g]) for g in greens]
    powers = np.stack([abs(f[0]) ** 2 / np.maximum(f[1], (1 / 65535) ** 2) for f in fields])
    m = (powers[0] + powers[1]) / 2
    score = np.zeros_like(m)
    # Separate padded slicing instead of the primary rolling-sum expression.
    padded = np.pad(m, 1, mode="wrap")
    for y in range(3):
        for x in range(3):
            score += padded[y : y + m.shape[0], x : x + m.shape[1]] / 9
    return score, powers


def qr_template_power(signal, greens):
    return sum(abs(qr_spectrum(signal[g], np.ones(signal.shape[-2:]))[0]) ** 2 for g in greens)


def reference_proximity(power, bins, radius):
    mask = independent_footprint(power.shape, bins, radius)
    fy, fx = [np.fft.fftfreq(n) / 2 for n in power.shape]
    half = np.broadcast_to(
        (fy[:, None] > 0) | ((fy[:, None] == 0) & (fx[None, :] > 0)), power.shape
    )
    angle = np.arctan2(fy[:, None], fx[None, :])
    details = {}
    for degrees in [0, 22.5]:
        a = (angle - math.radians(degrees)) % math.pi
        values = []
        energies = []
        captured = []
        total = float(power[half].sum())
        for s in range(4):
            cell = half & (a >= s * math.pi / 4) & (a < (s + 1) * math.pi / 4)
            e = float(power[cell].sum())
            v = float(power[cell & mask].sum())
            energies.append(e / total if total else 0)
            captured.append(v / total if total else 0)
            values.append(v / e if e else None)
        details[str(degrees)] = {
            "principal_energy_fractions": energies,
            "captured_principal_energy_fractions": captured,
            "within_sector_proximity": values,
            "minimum_proximity_among_sectors_with_at_least_5percent_power": min(
                v for v, e in zip(values, energies, strict=True) if e >= 0.05
            ),
        }
    return float(power[mask].sum() / power.sum()), details

def decimal_summary(rows, keys, expected):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        groups[tuple(r[k] for k in keys)].append(r)

    checks = 0
    for entry in expected:

            values = [r[field] for r in group]

            with localcontext() as ctx:
                ctx.prec = 50
                mean = float(sum(Decimal(str(v)) for v in values) / Decimal(n))
            assert abs(mean - stats["mean"]) < 1e-11 * max(1, abs(mean))
            for label, q in [("median", 0.5), ("p10", 0.1), ("p90", 0.9)]:
                at = q * (n - 1)

                hi = math.ceil(at)

def plot_data_check(result, figures):
    data = read(figures["plot_data"]["path"])

    inputs = lines(result["input_journal"]["path"])
    controls = lines(result["control_journal"]["path"])

    cdf = bars = overlap = quiet = 0
    for method in METHODS:
        group = [
            r
            for r in rows
            if r["method"] == method and r["present"] and r["neighborhood"] == "localwidth"
        ]
        order = np.argsort([r["template_fraction"] for r in group], kind="stable")
        expected = [100 * group[i]["template_fraction"] for i in order]
        a = data["present_template_CDF"][method]
        assert a["x_percent"] == expected and a["cases"] == [group[i]["id"] for i in order]
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(a["CDF"], np.arange(1, 257) / 256)
        cdf += len(expected)
        for field, a in data["minimum_sector_means"].items():
            assert a["methods"] == METHODS
            at = METHODS.index(method)
            expected = 100 * math.fsum(r[field] for r in group) / len(group)
            assert a["percent"][at] == expected
            bars += 1
        group = [r for r in inputs if r["kind"] == "mesh" and r["present"]]
        a = data["present_footprint_overlap"][method]
        assert a["cases"] == [r["id"] for r in group] and a["percent"] == [
            100 * r["stats"][method]["geometry_localwidth"]["overlap_fraction_of_unclipped_sum"]
            for r in group
        ]
        overlap += len(group)
        group = [r for r in controls if r["kind"] == "mixed-quiet" and r["method"] == method]
        a = data["quiet_global_local_power"][method]
        assert (
            a["cases"] == [r["id"] for r in group]
            and a["global"] == [r["global_max_min_phase_power"] for r in group]
            and a["local"] == [r["local_max_min_phase_power"] for r in group]
        )
        quiet += len(group)
    assert (cdf, bars, overlap, quiet) == (1024, 8, 1024, 128)
    return {
        "CDF_points": cdf,
        "sector_bars": bars,
        "overlap_samples": overlap,
        "paired_quiet_points": quiet,
